user_turns: Показывай сначала невыполненные записи, затем выполненные, внутри групп — от новых к старым.
Уточняю только обработку повреждённого файла: сохрани исходный файл рядом с резервным суффиксом, создай чистое хранилище и покажи понятное предупреждение. Остальной объём не меняй.
После завершения основных проверок добавь отдельную команду reopen для возврата выполненной записи в невыполненные, обнови план и повтори затронутые проверки.
Продолжай ту же задачу после восстановления с места, подтверждённого текущим состоянием.
Всё готово, доработок не нужно — после показа хронологии, плана и итоговых отчётов закрывай задачу.
stress_turns: Продолжай текущий шаг в рамках согласованного плана.
Сохраняй текущий объём задачи без новых требований.
После текущего шага продолжай к следующей проверке.
operator_actions: Submit the initial prompt only after the real composer is visible.
Across the bounded stages, exercise every packaged specialist profile exactly once where its responsibility is relevant, and verify the observed profile/model/effort in the native event stream.
While a worker is active, insert every stress_turn in quick succession and verify that queued messages are processed without dropped, duplicated, or reordered task decisions.
Answer the requested pre-plan sorting branch with the first user_turn; it is a real behavior choice and must produce a semantic revision rather than an ordinary clarification.
Approve only after a high-risk/material or explicitly requested decision-ready plan summary and verified plan link are visible.
Submit the direct point refinement after review so retirement uses the exact current outcome and reads only that outcome; do not ask for a duplicate confirmation.
Submit the later reopen-command addition only after the first implementation-dependent audit wave settles; require a new current plan and rerun only affected dependent nodes.
After a delivery assignment is visibly dispatched but before its publication, stop only the named CLI smoke session and resume the same ordinary thread with --resume-last; do not create a new task.

For Desktop, restart only the disposable development application while delegated work is unfinished, reopen the same task, and require the same read_state then read_continuations recovery without another open_task.
Before closure, require the visible newest-first chronology and verified plan/report links; then submit the predefined explicit close choice.
After the result is presented, open the mandatory closure review, submit the predefined close choice, verify the recorded decision, and only then call close_task.
Run the unchanged stamped candidate in CLI and Desktop consecutively, in either order.

conditional_operation_triggers.read_outcome: The post-approval corrupted-file refinement replaces one exact current outcome while preserving its other details.
conditional_operation_triggers.read_continuations: The same active task is recovered after a real CLI or disposable Desktop host restart while delegated work is unfinished.
conditional_operation_triggers.read_timeline: The original request explicitly requires a final decision chronology.
conditional_operation_triggers.open_steering: The sorting branch and later user-authored requirement changes alter product behavior.
conditional_operation_triggers.open_clarification: The final result has been presented and the mandatory revise-or-close review is opened.

acceptance: Every required operation has at least one successful task-relevant event on each host.
Every packaged agent profile is exercised at least once across the bounded live stages, with no profile silently substituted or omitted.
Multiple messages inserted while a worker is active are handled in order without dropped or duplicated user decisions, tool calls, or worker publications.
No Cortex tool error, validation error, schema error, traceback, hidden worker error, or unexplained successful mutation replay occurs.
The resumed CLI continuation retains the existing task and does not call open_task again.
After resume, one scalar state read routes unfinished delegated work to read_continuations; read_timeline is not used as a continuation lookup.
Repeated bounded waits while a worker remains active do not trigger read_state polling.
No implementation-dependent audit is dispatched before implementation evidence is terminal and acceptable; free slots never bypass predecessor readiness.
A partial report caused only by a knowingly missing predecessor fails the run instead of triggering duplicate audit work.
The coordinator never receives worker-only authority and every worker sees only its immutable selected scope.
The user sees decision context, the verified plan link, verified report links, and the requested chronology before the mandatory closure review.
close_task is rejected without a current closure review and succeeds only after the predefined close choice is recorded.
CLI and Desktop pass consecutively on the same unchanged cache-stamped payload.
